title: Structured Video-Language Modeling with Temporal Grouping and Spatial Grounding

layout.note: Two dotted-frame panels across the top (temporal grouping at left, spatial grounding at right) are tied by long dashed arrows to the token rows of the main two-column diagram below: the video column at left (input clip, Cut & Paste, Video Encoder, video and group tokens) and the text column at right (input caption, Noun Extraction & Prompting, Text Encoder, caption and noun tokens), meeting at a Contrastive Learning label.

lesson: Give each concept one colour and carry it through every representation (image region, learnable token, text token, word in the caption) so the correspondence being learned reads at a glance; put the objectives as titled dotted-frame insets above the main dual-encoder diagram and tie them to the token rows with long dashed arrows.
